|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4): the Players Committee card image, which prints the original release-sheet words again. The image here is that card image ([[:File:VB2-D-onearm-pre.gif]]); it was on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013, the folder's bulk upload date.
* '''Original''' ([[One-Arm (V)]]): Virtual Block 2 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 20)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 3, slip 20. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Habitat: Hoth sites. Deploys only to a marker site. Wampas are [Selective Creature]. Other wampas are ferocity and defense value +2. Once per game, may ▼ Wampa Cave.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-20-One_Arm.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 20 at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[One-Arm (V) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 2 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1220_20">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock2Type (Virtual Block 2 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205214/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Habitat: Hoth sites. Deploys only to a marker site. Wampas are [Selective Creature] creatures. Other wampas are ferocity and defense value +2. Once per game, may ▼ Wampa Cave on table.” '''What changed:''' Two changes: “creatures” is added after the [Selective Creature] icon, and “on table” is added after “Wampa Cave”. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-onearm-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual2-Dark">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual2-Dark/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034549/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “Habitat: Hoth sites. Deploys only to a marker site. Wampas are [Selective Creature]. Other wampas are ferocity and defense value +2. Once per game, may ▼ Wampa Cave.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It prints the same slip number as the release-sheet slip (20).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[One-Arm (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 16)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=16 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1220-20-front-master.png]]: “Habitat: Hoth sites. Deploys only to a marker site. Wampas are [Selective Creature]. Other wampas are ferocity and defense value +2. Once per game, may ▼ Wampa Cave.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the PC card image, PC-E2). The Master List slip prints no slip number. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
